_comment: Vertical twin of placement.json. Same format, same meaning -- the only
difference is the canvas it measures against: x and y are pixels in the
1080x1920 vertical canvas, not the 1920x1080 main one.
Loaded by the DeerV browser source in VCOMIC:
http://127.0.0.1:4460/mascot.html?set=deer&place=placement-vertical.json
mascot.html needed no changes for this -- it already takes `place`, and it
derives every bound from innerWidth/innerHeight rather than assuming 16:9.
x,y is the PIVOT: the point the gaze rotates about, sitting `pivot` of the
way down the cell (0.30 = roughly the head). Not the cell's top-left, and
not its centre.
Scenes named here are the same three the horizontal mascot appears on, so
the two pages stay consistent. A scene with no entry hides the mascot.
Spots were measured off the built page in canvas pixels, not eyeballed:
GAME  panel fills the frame exactly. The Game window bottoms out at 692
and the Cam window at 1214; the scrawl ends at 1367 and the tag
starts at 1851. That leaves a clear band on the right below the
webcam, which is where this sits -- cell 1370..1750, clear of both.
BRB   lands inside .mascot-frame, measured at 171,773,636,622. Centred in
it: a 460 cell in a 622-tall frame. Drawn art, never a hole, so the
mascot's own alpha reads against comic rather than live video.
CHAT  the tightest of the three. The portrait panel leaves only a 218px
gutter on the right, so this one is small and deliberately clips
the panel edge. It is the first to drop if it reads badly.
Re-author by dragging, same as the horizontal file:
http://127.0.0.1:4460/mascot.html?set=deer&place=placement-vertical.json&edit=1
in OBS via right-click -> Interact, then paste the JSON it prints.
